data.what_it_does: Provides serialization and deserialization for the MessagePack binary serialization format in Dart. It converts Dart objects to binary data and back without relying on dart:io.
use_when: You need to serialize data using MessagePack for compact binary transmission or storage
You require cross-platform serialization that works on the web as well as native platforms
avoid_when: You only need standard JSON serialization which is already built into Dart
You need complex code generation models for serialization
strengths: Works on all platforms including web
